While the study focuses on identifying substrates of kinases that create pHis and pAsp modifications, the proteomics analysis specifically monitors the biotin tag on the full-length protein (via trypsin digestion of the enriched proteins) rather than the labile phosphorylation sites themselves. The PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset', and the text confirms that the LC-MS/MS analysis monitors the 'full-length protein hit, not the modification directly'.
